description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableFeatureDefinition' implementing 'FeatureDefinition', including methods for JSON parsing, building, and standard object overrides. It manages a list of feature identifiers and provides a builder for construction.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureDefinition
classes.description: Immutable implementation of FeatureDefinition managing a list of DefinitionIdentifier objects.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureDefinition.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing ImmutableFeatureDefinition instances with fluent API.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JsonArray to create an ImmutableFeatureDefinition, ignoring non-string values and throwing exceptions for null, empty, or invalid data.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder initialized with the first identifier.

methods.name: getFirstIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the first DefinitionIdentifier in the list.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a stream of the identifiers.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the identifiers.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the identifiers to a JsonArray.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on identifier list.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on identifier list.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object.
